Outlining the changes that we're being considered for family childcare homes, childcare centers and adult day cares.

There are three uses being reviewed this evening. The first is family childcare homes. These are always accessory to a dwelling where the owner operator resides in a dwelling.
Family childcare homes allow for up to eight children and care. And there is an outdoor place-based requirement of 3.25 meter squared per child.
Child care centers may be approved as a principal use or an accessory use. And there's an outdoor place-based requirement of 3.5 meter squared.
And adult day cares are defined in the zoning bylaw as a placement care or supervision of adults.
And there are two types. Type 1 which provides for care for up to five persons and type 2 which provides for care for more than five persons.
None of these uses provide for overnight supervision.

The amendment will allow for up to 12 persons and care to be permitted in a day care which is accessory to a dwelling.
